user_goal: Create, edit, reorder, and delete product categories — with photos/video and SEO fields — so the catalog stays organized and ready to publish to the storefront.
business_goal: An accurate, well-merchandised category structure is what makes the storefront's browsing/filtering usable and drives product discovery.

user_journey.step: Create a new category with images and SEO fields

happy_path.expected_result: Table renders with columns Order, Category, Slug, Products, Status; "Add Category" link visible top-right (CategoriesTable.tsx)
Navigates to /categories/new; page renders titled "New Category" with an empty CategoryForm

happy_path.action: Type a name into the Name field
happy_path.selector: input for label "Name *", placeholder "e.g. Business Stationery" (CategoryForm.tsx)
happy_path.expected_result: Value accepted; in create mode this also drives hp-04's auto-slug

happy_path.action: Observe the Slug field after typing Name
happy_path.expected_result: Slug auto-derives from Name via local slugify() (lowercase, non-alnum -> '-', trimmed) — create mode only, per CategoryForm.tsx

happy_path.action: Upload one image via the media dropzone
happy_path.selector: MediaSection dropzone, text "Drag & drop or click to upload images"
happy_path.expected_result: Status line changes from the red "1 more photo(s) required — minimum 1." to "Minimum of 1 photo met (1/4)."; uploaded image gets a "Primary" badge

happy_path.action: Return to the categories list and find the new row
happy_path.expected_result: New category appears with the entered name/slug and an "Active" status badge

happy_path.action: Use the row's Up arrow to move it earlier in order
happy_path.selector: icon-only button (ArrowUp) in the Order column for that row
happy_path.expected_result: PATCH /admin/categories/reorder fires with the full id list in new order; row visually moves

happy_path.action: Edit the category: change its Name only
happy_path.selector: "Edit" menu item (Pencil icon) inside the row's action dropdown -> /categories/{id}, then the Name input
happy_path.expected_result: Save button reads "Save Changes"; on submit, toast "Category updated"; Slug does NOT change (auto-slug only runs in create mode)

happy_path.selector: "Delete" menu item (Trash2 icon, red) -> ConfirmDialog, then "Delete Category" button
happy_path.expected_result: Dialog text: Delete "{name}"? / "This will remove the category. The N product(s) in it will become uncategorized."; on confirm, toast "\"{name}\" deleted" and the row disappears from the list

alternate_paths.path_name: Optional fields: video and SEO metadata

steps.action: Upload an optional category video during create
steps.selector: video dropzone, text "Drag & drop or click to upload video"
steps.expected_result: Accepted up to 150MB (.mp4/.mov/.webm); thumbnail extracted automatically per the helper text

steps.action: Fill Meta Title and Meta Description under "SEO — optional"
steps.selector: labels "Meta Title" and "Meta Description", each with a live char counter
steps.expected_result: Values save; counters are advisory only (see edge-05 — no hard max enforced)

steps.action: Start creating a category, upload an image, then click "Cancel" without submitting
steps.expected_result: Navigates back to /categories; mediaRef.current?.cleanupNewUploads() deletes the orphaned upload from storage (best-effort, not assertable from the UI alone — see gaps)

error_paths.expected_ui_response: Zod error rendered near the media section: "At least 1 photo is required" (errors.image_keys.message, CategoryForm.tsx); form does not submit

error_paths.trigger: Submit "Create Category" with an empty Name
error_paths.expected_ui_response: Zod error "Name is required" (schema: name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'), CategoryForm.tsx:16-25) — exact rendered location not directly confirmed, see gaps

error_paths.trigger: Submit "Create Category" with a slug that already belongs to another category
error_paths.expected_ui_response: Backend returns 409 (slug_exists check, category_repository.py); frontend's catch block is a bare generic handler that shows the SAME toast — "Failed to save category" — for this and every other failure type (network error, 422, 500). This is a real UX gap: the user gets no indication the problem was specifically a duplicate slug.

edge_cases.case: A staff user with categories.view but not categories.manage (e.g. the customer_support or marketing role) navigates directly to /categories or /categories/new by URL
edge_cases.risk_note: Confirmed gap: usePermissions.ts exposes canManageCategories but it is referenced nowhere in the category UI — a view-only role sees fully-enabled Add/Edit/Delete/Reorder controls with no disabling and no read-only notice (unlike the pattern used for Reviews/Content elsewhere in this app). Any mutation attempt will 403 from the backend with no client forewarning. Reachable today via the customer_support or marketing roles per permissions.ts.

edge_cases.case: Delete a category that has products in it
edge_cases.existing_validation: Backend nullify_products() sets those products' category_id to NULL and unlinks any nav links pointing at the category, rather than blocking the delete or cascading. Confirm dialog copy discloses this: "...The N product(s) in it will become uncategorized."
edge_cases.risk_note: Assert the products still exist afterward with no category (not that they vanish) — a naive test might wrongly expect a block or a cascade delete.

edge_cases.case: Slug typed manually with uppercase letters, spaces, or symbols
edge_cases.existing_validation: None — the Zod schema only checks .min(1); the backend Pydantic schema also has no regex/pattern constraint on slug.
edge_cases.risk_note: A malformed slug (spaces/uppercase/symbols) will save as-is. slug_exists() does an exact case-sensitive string match, and the storefront's getCategoryBySlug() lookup is also exact-match — a non-URL-safe slug could produce a category the storefront can't cleanly route to. Worth asserting what actually happens to that category's storefront URL.

edge_cases.case: Meta Title / Meta Description entered beyond the 60 / 160 character counter thresholds
edge_cases.existing_validation: The counter turns visually red past the limit, but there is no Zod max — the value is not blocked from submitting.
edge_cases.risk_note: Confirm an over-limit value saves in full rather than being silently truncated somewhere in the pipeline.

edge_cases.case: Reorder using the boundary arrows — Up on the first row, Down on the last row
edge_cases.risk_note: Not confirmed by static reading whether these are disabled at the boundary or simply no-ops; verify live rather than assuming either.

edge_cases.case: Upload a video file larger than 150MB
edge_cases.existing_validation: Client-side size check in MediaSection.tsx (MAX_VIDEO_MB = 150) rejects before any upload request, with error text "Video is too large (X MB). Maximum is 150 MB."
edge_cases.risk_note: Confirm no network request is attempted once the client-side check fails.

edge_cases.case: Upload an image whose short side is under 800px
edge_cases.existing_validation: Client-only, non-blocking advisory: an amber badge/tooltip appears on the thumbnail.
edge_cases.risk_note: Confirm this never blocks save — it's advisory only, per MediaSection.tsx.

gaps: The post-create and post-edit redirect target (does it return to /categories, or stay on the edit page?) was not confirmed by static reading — verify live during test execution and record the actual behavior in the run.

Whether Name/Slug field-level Zod errors actually render inline under those specific inputs (vs. only a toast) was not directly confirmed in the JSX — only the image_keys error's exact rendering was confirmed. Verify live.

No seeded admin login credentials were located during grounding. /qa:generate-tests needs real credentials (check urgent-printers-backend's seed scripts) before it can drive an authenticated flow — this blocks live execution until supplied.
Whether deleted category media (image_keys/video_key) is actually removed from R2 storage is asserted by the backend code path (_delete_category_media) but is not verifiable from the admin UI alone.
